arguments.query: SELECT booking_id, status, flight_id, passenger_id, amount_cents FROM bookings ORDER BY booking_id LIMIT 30

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, c.charge_id, c.idempotency_key, c.amount_cents, c.provider_state, h.hold_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" AND name IN ("charges", "holds", "bookings")

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_id) as charge_count, MAX(c.state) as charge_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.hold_id) as hold_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" GROUP BY b.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_id) as charge_count, MAX(c.state) as charge_state, CASE WHEN h.booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_hold FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" GROUP BY b.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT b.booking_id, c.charge_id, c.state FROM bookings b JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" AND c.state = "captured" ORDER BY b.booking_id
